mergePdf.name: Merge PDF
mergePdf.longDescription: Merge multiple PDF files into a single document. Drag and drop to reorder pages before combining.

splitPdf.name: Split PDF
splitPdf.longDescription: Extract specific pages or split your PDF into individual files. Choose custom page ranges.

rotatePdf.name: Rotate PDF
rotatePdf.longDescription: Rotate individual pages or all pages at once. Add pages from other PDFs. Visual workspace with instant preview.

deletePdf.name: Delete PDF Pages
deletePdf.longDescription: Delete individual pages or multiple pages at once. Add pages from other PDFs. Visual workspace with instant preview.

extractPdf.name: Extract PDF Pages
extractPdf.description: Extract specific pages from your PDF
extractPdf.longDescription: Select and extract specific pages into a new PDF. Click pages to select, then download — visual workspace with instant preview.

compressPdf.name: Compress PDF
compressPdf.longDescription: Compress your PDF files without losing quality. Perfect for email attachments and uploads.

pdfToWord.name: PDF to Word
pdfToWord.longDescription: Convert PDF to editable Word (.docx) with real text, headings, bullet lists, and tables you can edit in Microsoft Word or Google Docs.

wordToPdf.name: Word to PDF
wordToPdf.longDescription: Convert your Word documents (.doc, .docx) to PDF format with perfect formatting.

jpgToPdf.name: JPG to PDF
jpgToPdf.longDescription: Convert JPG, PNG, and other image formats to PDF. Combine multiple images into one PDF.

htmlToPdf.name: HTML to PDF
htmlToPdf.longDescription: Convert HTML files to pixel-perfect PDF documents. Full CSS support, images, SVG, and complex layouts.

txtToPdf.name: TXT to PDF
txtToPdf.longDescription: Convert TXT, LOG, CSV, Markdown, JSON, XML, and other text files to professionally formatted PDF documents with customizable fonts and layouts.

signPdf.name: Sign PDF
signPdf.longDescription: Sign your PDF documents digitally. Draw, type, or upload your signature.

editPdf.name: Edit PDF
editPdf.description: Add text and whiteout edits to PDF pages
editPdf.longDescription: Edit PDF pages in your browser — add text, adjust fonts, and cover areas with whiteout before downloading an updated PDF.

aiPdfSummarizer.name: AI PDF Summarizer
aiPdfSummarizer.longDescription: Use AI to get instant summaries, key points, and insights from your PDF documents.

pdfScanner.name: PDF Scanner
pdfScanner.longDescription: Convert scanned images and photos of documents into clean, searchable PDFs.

unlockPdf.name: Unlock PDF
unlockPdf.longDescription: Remove password protection from your PDF files. You must know the password to unlock.

protectPdf.name: Protect PDF
protectPdf.longDescription: Secure your PDF files with password protection. Set permissions for printing and editing.

pdfToExcel.name: PDF to Excel
pdfToExcel.longDescription: Extract text and tables from PDF into an editable Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheet.

pdfToPpt.name: PDF to PowerPoint
pdfToPpt.longDescription: Turn each PDF page into a full-slide image in an editable PowerPoint (.pptx) presentation — layout, charts, and graphics preserved.

excelToPdf.name: Excel to PDF
excelToPdf.longDescription: Convert Excel (.xls, .xlsx) files to PDF with table layout preserved.

pptToPdf.name: PowerPoint to PDF
pptToPdf.longDescription: Convert PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx) presentations to PDF format.

addWatermark.name: Add Watermark
addWatermark.longDescription: Stamp a text or image watermark on every page of your PDF document.

faq.q1: What's included in the Free plan?
faq.a1: The Free plan includes merge, split, compress, convert, and other basic PDF tools — up to 5 uses per day with up to {freeSize} MB per file. No credit card required for most tools.
faq.q2: What happens when I hit the daily limit?
faq.a2: Once you've used 5 tools in a day, you'll need to wait until the next day or upgrade to Pro for 100 daily uses. Your account and file history stay intact.
faq.q3: Can I switch from monthly to yearly billing?
faq.a3: Choose monthly or yearly at checkout. To change your billing cycle later, cancel auto-renew and purchase the plan you want, or contact support.
faq.q4: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a4: We accept UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking, and wallets through Razorpay. All transactions are processed securely in INR.
faq.a5: Absolutely. Files are encrypted during transfer and automatically deleted after processing. We never access, store permanently, or share your documents.
faq.a6: Yes — contact support@onlymypdf.in within 7 days of your most recent Pro payment for a refund. Include your Razorpay payment ID.
faq.q7: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.a7: Absolutely. Cancel from your dashboard anytime. You'll keep Pro access until the end of your current billing period.
faq.q8: Do you offer a team or business plan?
faq.a8: Yes — our Business plan includes team seats, custom limits, API access, and dedicated support. Click Contact Sales on the pricing page or email us for a tailored quote.
